summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Gopikrishna's ePortfolio. All 7 pytest backend tests passed (PIN verify correct/wrong/missing, contact create+GET persistence, invalid email 422, missing message 422, sort recency). Frontend E2E via Playwright: hero shows 'Gopikrishna Rajendran' + headshot + stats, all 7 nav links + Resume button present, Academic PIN gate correctly denies 0000 (ACCESS DENIED shown, 0 cards) and unlocks with 4346 revealing all 13 academic cards, Pipeline tabs (projects/games/hobbies) all present and switchable, Projects section renders 9 project cards, Contact form submits successfully (form cleared + success toast 'Message sent — I'll be in touch soon.' shown + message persisted in MongoDB via GET /api/contact).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as ISO string but converts back to datetime on GET — works, but consider storing as native BSON datetime for proper index-based sorting.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec; browsers ignore credentials with wildcard. Low risk since no auth cookies used.
seed_data_creation: Inserted a few TEST_ contact messages via API during testing (5 total in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working. backend_test.py uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Playwright: use element.scroll_into_view_if_needed rather than window.scroll due to lenis smooth scroll. PIN input is a data-testid='pin-input' hidden input — fill directly with '4346'.
